column1: # 1. Open an incognito window. Do not sign in.
# 2. Go to google.com and search the term. Stay on the "All" tab.
# 3. DO NOT use the "AI Mode" tab. AI Mode is a separate conversational surface and is not what Semrush measures.
# 4. Look for the block labelled "AI Overview" at the top of the results. Click "Show more" to expand it.
# 5. Open the source list on the right of that block. Record every domain you see
# 6. If no AI Overview block appears at all
column2: write "none" in the AI Overview shown column.
a few minutes apart. Google often shows an AI Overview on one run and not the next.
